pokedexEntries.dp: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

pokedexEntries.pt: A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement.

pokedexEntries.hg: A frozen MAMOSWINE was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.
